name: soccer-fixtures-odds-math
title: Soccer Fixtures, Settlement & Odds Math (MCP tools as API)
description: One-call soccer toolkit: fixtures and results for any day (all comps), bet settlement vs real scorelines, de-vig (power), EV/minimum odds/Kelly pricing, parlay math, plus Team-Mood news sentiment per club (LLM-scored, crypto-style). No API key. Each run executes one tool call, JSON to dataset.

arguments.title: Arguments (JSON object of tool kwargs)
arguments.description: Tool kwargs: get_fixtures/get_results {date, league?}, settle_picks {picks:[...], date?}, devig_market {prices:[...]}, evaluate_price {probability, odds, margin_pct?, kelly_fraction?}, parlay_math {legs:[...]}, get_team_sentiment {date?, teams?: ["Bayern", "Union"]} — Team-Mood cards (news sentiment per team)
